title: Arches: n m r h
objective: Start at the dot, pull straight down, then spring back up into the arch. Keep every arch the same height.
self_check: Circle the best arch in each row. Does every arch reach the dashed line?
deep_dive: Arches share one motion: down-stroke, retrace up the stem, then branch out about halfway up. Practise the motion and four letters come for free.
